source: MSVC vtable slots read from the flat-API wrappers of a 32-bit steam_api.dll (SHA-256 ce6f48938493...) shipped with a Steam game used as a reference; the version string is the one embedded in that DLL. Extracted with tools/steam-flat-argsizes.py --tables-out on 2026-09-13. Names and slot numbers only, no third-party bytes. Ambiguous slots (several wrappers call the same slot): {7: ['CheckPingDataUpToDate', 'InitRelayNetworkAccess'], 14: ['SetConfigValue', 'SetConfigValueStruct', 'SetConnectionConfigValueFloat', 'SetConnectionConfigValueInt32', 'SetConnectionConfigValueString', 'SetGlobalCallback_MessagesSessionFailed', 'SetGlobalCallback_MessagesSessionRequest', 'SetGlobalCallback_SteamNetAuthenticationStatusChanged', 'SetGlobalCallback_SteamNetConnectionStatusChanged', 'SetGlobalCallback_SteamRelayNetworkStatusChanged', 'SetGlobalConfigValueFloat', 'SetGlobalConfigValueInt32', 'SetGlobalConfigValuePtr', 'SetGlobalConfigValueString']}.
